paragraphs.text:
Abruptly, the contest ends. The hag collapses to the ground. As 
the Keywanema cease their chanting, one of them hurries to 
the old woman’s aid. She lies inert. You cannot even tell if she 
is breathing.

The  Keywanema  cluster  around  their  hideous  queen  and 
pick her up. They hurry away with her, leaving the three of you 
in the glen, still bound, but alone and unguarded.
